items.statement: The flag's sensitivity for urgent messages across the study clinics will be at least 85 percent.
Sensitivity will be at least 10 points lower for messages in languages other than English.
items.risks: Few such messages if clinic C pauses.

items.statement: Silent flagging would move urgent messages to the front of the queue a median of 3 hours earlier.
items.rationale: Urgent messages currently wait in one queue.
items.risks: Queue time estimates depend on timestamps.
